name: @nix/api-client
description: The single gateway between the Nix frontend and Core: one axios instance, single-flight token refresh, RFC 9457 error mapping, Zod boundary parsing and a small server-state cache

scripts.generate: openapi-typescript ../../backend/openapi/nix-api.json -o src/generated/api.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/build-operations.ts && prettier --write src/generated/api.ts src/generated/operations.ts
